			date > 1761.2.28
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 1.25 }
			date > 1767.8.30
		}
		AND = {
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace > 0.1 }
			check_variable = { global.zin_story_pace < 0.9 }
			date > 1757.11.29
		}
	}
}
zin_path_cp26_overdue = {
